title: Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Musician Intake 01/2027 Online Form
vacancyDetails: Agniveervayu Musician Rally Recruitment for Intake 01/2027 under Agnipath scheme
qualification: Passed Matriculation / 10th class with Music as one of the subjects or equivalent; musical proficiency / skill as per IAF Musician Rally notification
ageLimit: As per IAF Agniveervayu (Musician) Intake 01/2027 notification (born within dates specified)
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS / SC / ST : ₹100/- (Pay via Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking)
selectionProcess: Online Registration → Proficiency / Skill Test (Musician) → Physical Fitness Test → Adaptability Tests → Medical Examination → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, music-related certificates (if any), photo ID (Aadhaar), passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit the official Agniveervayu Musician application portal
2. Complete Step I registration (mobile & email OTP)
3. Login and fill personal, communication and qualification details
4. Upload photograph, signature, thumb impression and required documents
5. Pay application fee and submit before 02 August 2026
shortDescription: IAF Agniveer Vayu Musician Intake 01/2027 Online Form open. Apply from 20 July 2026 to 02 August 2026. Official notification available.
content:
आवेदन शुरू ✅

Indian Air Force has released the online form for Agniveer Vayu Musician Intake 01/2027 (Musician Rally Recruitment).

Eligible candidates can apply online from 20 July 2026 to 02 August 2026. Official notification is available.

  • Post: Agniveervayu (Musician) – Intake 01/2027
  • Application Start: 20 July 2026
  • Last Date: 02 August 2026
  • Application Fee: ₹100/- for all categories
  • Selection: Skill / proficiency test, PFT, adaptability, medical

Read the official notification carefully for musical proficiency standards, age limit, and rally venue details before applying.
